 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant, as he has been arrested on 09.04.2023 in connection with FIR/Crime No.55/2023, Date:- Not mentioned registered at P.S.-Harangaon, District-Dewas (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(N) and 506 of the IPC.
2. Prosecution story in brief is that, at the time of incident the prosecutrix was aged 18 years and 8 months.
Prior to the incident, prosecutrix and applicant were living in the same village and also knew each other.
On 05.04.2023 at around 12 A.M. mother of the prosecutrix was sleeping in the house, applicant came in her house and told her that he want to marry with her.

sentences.text: the prosecutrix to go with him, therefore, the prosecutrix went with the applicant by motorcycle.
The applicant took her near a temple situated at Salkanpur.
He kept her for two days and committed rape upon her.
On 09.04.2023, FIR was lodged against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
There was love affection between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
But parents of the prosecutrix pressurize her to lodged report hence, she lodged report against the applicant.
Applicant is in custody since 09.04.2023.
After completion of the investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of the trial will take sufficient time for its disposal therefore, on these grounds prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4 . Per contra, learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer of the applicant and prays for its rejection.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that final disposal of the case will take sufficient long time, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant-Satish be released on bail upon his/her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7. This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Satish vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41595795/
